items.label: USAO-CT civil: Clinical Science Laboratory, Inc.
items.detail: False Claims Act settlement announced by the Connecticut US Attorney and Connecticut AG over a Mansfield, Massachusetts lab charging Connecticut Medicaid far above its other customer prices; date is the announcement date. Lab and its two owners paid $1,508,106 together; owners left out. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-usao-ct-2019-clinical-science-laboratory; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.reason: Shared total, split not stated: The lab and its two individual owners pay one total; the Connecticut AG states only the state/federal split ($904,863 to Connecticut). Flag: the conduct was billing Connecticut Medicaid, yet the row sits in the ma_conduct lens; the lens tag should be re-read. Source (read 2026-10-11): "CSL, Elfbaum and Amoruso agreed to pay $1,508,106". The primary document gives one total for payers that include anyone outside the company, so the total is counted for no company; the row stays in gross (overlap group shared-usao-ct-2019-clinical-science-laboratory; data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
excluded_amounts.category_label: Split not stated by the source (cash from relief, or between payers)
